### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces—from clean energy and climate resilience to medicine, infrastructure, and space travel. We believe the impact will be transformational.

2. We see superintelligent AI as the ultimate engineering force multiplier. If it is built within the next 20 years, humanity will gain solutions to every major engineering challenge holding back health, prosperity, sustainability, and exploration.

3. Every major engineering problem is ultimately a problem of discovery, design, and execution. Superintelligent AI will master all three. If we build it within the next 20 years, it will solve humanity’s greatest engineering challenges.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. It will design abundant clean energy systems, transform medicine, create resilient infrastructure, accelerate climate restoration, revolutionize transportation, and unlock capabilities that today remain beyond our reach. This is not simply another technological advance. It is the arrival of an intelligence able to understand complex systems, test solutions at extraordinary speed, and turn breakthroughs into working technologies. The consequences will reach every community and every sector. We are entering a period in which humanity can overcome its hardest technical limits—and build a healthier, safer, more prosperous future for everyone.
